# opsward

> Diagnose, generate, and maintain the AI agent setup of your projects — CLAUDE.md, skills, subagents, rules, and supporting docs.


## Pages

- [opsward](index.html.md): Diagnose, generate, and maintain the AI agent setup of your projects —
- [API reference](api.html.md): | &#96;opsward&#96;   | Diagnose, generate, and maintain the AI agent setup of your projects.   |
- [opsward](_autosummary/opsward.html.md): Diagnose, generate, and maintain the AI agent setup of your projects.
- [opsward.base](_autosummary/opsward.base.html.md): All dataclasses and type definitions for opsward.
- [opsward.cli](_autosummary/opsward.cli.html.md): CLI dispatch for opsward.
- [opsward.data](_autosummary/opsward.data.html.md): Bundled package resources for opsward, accessed via &#96;importlib.resources.files("opsward.data")&#96;.
- [opsward.data.templates](_autosummary/opsward.data.templates.html.md): Generation templates organized by target project type.
- [opsward.decisions](_autosummary/opsward.decisions.html.md): Decision capture: numbered ADRs, the one-line decision log, and their drift.
- [opsward.discover](_autosummary/opsward.discover.html.md): Optional cross-repo asset discovery, delegating to the &#96;toolery&#96; package.
- [opsward.evals](_autosummary/opsward.evals.html.md): Eval harness (opsward#17, gap 3): opt-in, report-only quality signals beyond the rubric.
- [opsward.fleet](_autosummary/opsward.fleet.html.md): Diagnose every root and aggregate. A root that fails is recorded, never fatal.
- [opsward.generate](_autosummary/opsward.generate.html.md): Determine which artifacts are missing, render templates, return files to create.
- [opsward.lint](_autosummary/opsward.lint.html.md): Schema lint (opsward#17, gap 2): spec and config violations, pass or fail, no score.
- [opsward.maintain](_autosummary/opsward.maintain.html.md): Detect maintenance issues and return suggestions.
- [opsward.recommend](_autosummary/opsward.recommend.html.md): Recommend skills from the ecosystem based on project tech stack.
- [opsward.scan](_autosummary/opsward.scan.html.md): Scan &#42;project_root&#42; and return a ScanResult.
- [opsward.score](_autosummary/opsward.score.html.md): Pure scoring functions. ScanResult -&gt; DiagnosisReport.
- [opsward.security](_autosummary/opsward.security.html.md): Security advisories (opsward#17, gap 5): “valid” is not “safe to ship”.
- [opsward.subagents](_autosummary/opsward.subagents.html.md): Reuse a skill as a subagent: declare it in the skill, generate the twin, check the sync.
- [opsward.util](_autosummary/opsward.util.html.md): Shared helpers for opsward.
